description: v1 (2026-09-22): the night chain runner (guild_hall/context_engine/ops/night_chain.mjs) plus its scheduled-task registrar and hidden launcher (ops/register-night-chain-task.ps1, ops/run-night-chain-hidden.vbs). The runner replaces a set of independently-clocked nightly tasks for an Owner-chosen ordered subset -- each step is another already-built lane's own entry point, run as a separate CHILD PROCESS (`node <lane_root>/<entry> <args>`) only after the previous step's own exit code and, when the config names one, its own fresh receipt said success -- driven by an external sha256-pinned chain config (see docs/architecture/workspace/examples/night_chain/night_chain.example.json for the shape and the intended order voice_cards -> mail_ledgers -> mail_attribution_index -> graph_sync_once -> voice_cards_to_index [disabled placeholder]). tracked_paths are exactly three files, not a directory prefix: night_chain.mjs imports node: builtins ONLY -- its relative-import closure, computed with guild_hall/deployment_pack/tools/spec_closure_lib.mjs's moduleClosure() from that one entry point, is the single file itself. It deliberately reimplements (rather than imports) the deadline arithmetic of harness/voice_conversation_list_nightly.mjs, the lock shape every nightly lane here uses, a lane-manifest FILE digest check (the same value every register-*-task.ps1 pins with Get-Sha256File, not build_source_lane.mjs's per-entry verifyLane), and a host-path redactor equivalent to guild_hall/workspace_ledgers/src/refresh.mjs's redactHostPaths -- so this lane needs neither the context engine's runtime closure nor any other module, and each step's own lane stays pinned by its own LANE_MANIFEST.sha256 inside the chain config. No carried_forward_prefixes: nothing here needs node_modules. Its tests (guild_hall/context_engine/tests/night_chain.test.mjs, tests/register_night_chain_task.test.mjs) live in the already-excluded tests/ directory of the sibling lanes and are not carried. This spec registers no task and builds no lane by itself. Same-day fresh-eyes review fixes (still v1, tracked_paths/entry_points unchanged, import closure still the one file): the runner refuses unknown flags and bare positionals, reports NOTHING_TO_RUN (exit 7) when every in-scope step is disabled, refuses --from on a disabled step like --only, carries each step's own deadline/note into its receipt row, records the config file by basename only, compares receipt freshness as mtime >= start ms + 1, and lists a disabled step after an on_failure stop as SKIPPED_DISABLED; the registrar lowers $ErrorActionPreference around its --dry preflight. The lane id was NOT bumped for these: night-chain-v1 had never been built anywhere but a throwaway temp directory before this fix landed, so there is no running copy for a drift check to tell apart -- unlike graph-sync-v3 -> v4 the same day.
